preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 500 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 1 and the minimum of n*(n-1) and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) has vertices u and v between 1 and n inclusive, and u is not equal to v.
The number of edges in the input list matches the given m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any((graph - {edge}).is_acyclic() for edge in edges) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists at least one edge whose removal makes the graph acyclic, otherwise 'NO'.
